changelog:
- Initial release of four-layer-photo-poster skill.
- Creates one high-design 3:4 vertical poster per input photo, structured as four equal horizontal bands: original photo, selective-memory stickers, watercolor ticket, and gilded enamel magnet.
- Requires a two-stage workflow: generate four panoramic layer assets per photo and assemble with an included script for precise alignment.
- Ensures subject integrity and visual consistency across all bands; no collaging or mixing of multiple photos.
- Text is only added if supplied or unambiguously visible—never inferred or generated by default.
- Assembled output is always an exact 3:4 canvas with four seamless, contiguous bands.
summary: Turn each supplied photo into its own 3:4 vertical, four-stage design poster with exact four-band assembly and a continuous source scene.
